device.description: 12-bit 8 MSPS 2-input simultaneous-sampling pipelined ADC with parallel uP interface
device.note: slas288b.pdf (SLAS288B, THS1209) p.1 pinout, p.2 recommended operating conditions, p.4 timing requirements, p.5 terminal functions, p.14-16 conversion (one conversion per CONV_CLK falling edge, 5-clock latency, SYNC), p.17 data format (Tables 2-5), p.18 control register map and addressing (Tables 6-7), p.19 initialization, p.20-21 CR0 (Tables 8-10), p.22 CR1 (Table 11), p.23-26 read/write timing

registers.name: CR0
registers.note: control register 0 (RA1 RA0 = 00); reset values: DIFF0 = 1, all else 0 (differential AINP-AINM)

registers.name: CR1
registers.note: control register 1 (RA1 RA0 = 01); reset values: bits 5 and 4 = 1 (reserved), all else 0

commands.name: CR1 write with RESET = 1
commands.note: writing 1 to CR1 bit 0 resets CR0/CR1 to their reset values

commands.name: CR1 write with RBACK = 1 (debug mode)
commands.note: the first read after RBACK is set returns CR0, the second (and, in the model, later ones) CR1 (protocol.reads)

pages: p.1 (pinout), p.2 (ROC), p.4 (timing), p.5 (terminal functions), p.14-16 (conversion), p.17 (data format), p.18-22 (control registers), p.23-26 (timing)
notModeled: analog inputs, references (internal/external VREF select), REFOUT: the result is always the 0 V code; codeFormat follows CR1 BIN/2s for the power-on differential configuration (0 V differential = 000h twos complement / mid-scale binary); in single-ended configurations 0 V lies below the VREFM-VREFP input range
CS1 (active-high chip select): the model selects on CS0 alone; CS1 must be held high

R/W mode (CR1 bit 6 = 1: WR becomes R/W, RD disabled): stored only; the bus always uses separate RD and WR (the power-on/reset setting); the datasheet notes RD/WR start conditions are unknown and the first access must be a write
addresses RA1 RA0 = 10 and 11 (reserved) are ignored
the channel sequence (CHSEL/DIFF/SCAN autoscan of up to 2 inputs) is stored only; every read returns the 0 V code
test mode (CR0 TEST1/TEST0: VREFP, mid-scale, VREFM test voltages) is stored only; reads still return the 0 V code
offset cancellation (CR1 OFFSET) is stored only
pipeline latency (5 CONV_CLK cycles) and the CONV_CLK-to-read setup times are not modeled (the code is constant)
tDf uses the 5 ns maximum data hold time after the first CS invalid (th)
SYNC output (low while channel-A data is on the bus in multichannel mode, disabled with one input) is not driven; SRST (sync generator reset) is stored only
conversion: one conversion per CONV_CLK falling edge (continuous clock), conversion time 0
CR1 RESET: the datasheet holds the device in reset until a 0 is written to the bit; the model resets once (the bit reads back 0)
debug read-back (RBACK): D11/D10 during the CR0/CR1 read-back are not specified; modeled as 0. Reads after the second keep returning CR1 until RBACK is cleared
RESET pin polarity: active low per the pinout overbar (p.1); the terminal table gives no level
power down (CR0 PD) blocks conversions; reads and writes still work, as the datasheet states
vcc is the union of DVDD and BVDD ranges (BVDD 3-5.25 V for the output buffers)
variants: THS1009 is the 10-bit relative (RA0/RA1 separate pins, no read-back).
